title: Banjo versus guitar in the band
summary: Banjo was the only instrument then; he prefers guitar because it is easier, was self-taught on it, and says modern guitars need amplifiers while the banjo carries in a band.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role
